definitions.gloss: here and there; scattered; dotted about
definitions.explanation: Describing things scattered in dots across a space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点々|てんてん}と⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming here and there across the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{血痕|けっこん}→血痕：28316_kekkon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点々|てんてん}と⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Blood traces were dotted along the path.

examples.japanese: ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点々|てんてん}と⟦{浮|う}かんでいる→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: Islands are scattered about (on the sea).

notes:
{点々|てんてん} is a reduplication of ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point; dot), describing things distributed in a scattered, dot-like pattern.

USAGE:
- {点々|てんてん}と + verb (in a scattered manner)
- {点々|てんてん}と⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (dotted continuously)

VISUAL IMAGE:
This word evokes a visual of dots scattered across a surface, like stars in the sky, islands in the sea, or flowers in a meadow.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{転々|てんてん}→転々：03975_tenten⟧ - has the same reading but different meaning (moving from place to place). See separate entry.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぽつぽつ→ぽつぽつ：06683_potsupotsu⟧ (sparsely; little by little)
- ⟦まばら→まばら：10525_mabara⟧に (sparsely; scattered)
